label: VERIFIED
extraction: Orch Fix Defect: orchestrates fixing a bug - reproduce it as a failing regression test, fix to green, review, and gated commit - by delegating each phase to the matching ECC agent. Use when existing behavior is broken or wrong. Leverages orch-pipeline shared engine. First-move rule: reproduce as failing test before any fix attempt. Ensures systematic bug fixing with regression prevention. Composes existing ECC commands: /feature-dev, /plan, /code-review, /build-fix, /refactor-clean, /gan-build, plus tdd-workflow skill. Adds shared size classifier and two gates (plan approval, commit approval) on top.
